question: Which repository had the biggest jump in activity, and what was discussed at the time?
sql:
WITH deltas AS (
    SELECT
        repo_slug,
        year_month,
        commits,
        commits - LAG(commits) OVER (PARTITION BY repo_slug ORDER BY year_month) AS commit_jump
    FROM v_repo_activity
),
top_jump AS (
    SELECT repo_slug, year_month, commit_jump
    FROM deltas
    ORDER BY commit_jump DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    t.repo_slug,
    t.year_month,
    t.commit_jump,
    c.subject AS commit_subject
FROM top_jump t
JOIN v_commit c ON c.repo_slug = t.repo_slug AND c.year_month = t.year_month
ORDER BY c.authored_at
